open_obligations: Note that Du et al. generate answers, while Cohen et al. classify claims as correct or incorrect.
Check how Du et al. grade biographies and whether that grading is reliable enough to compare with Cohen et al.'s factuality judgements.
Check whether Du et al. report a majority-vote baseline on these factuality tasks.
out.other_title: Future work: multiple examiners, trained examiners, and analysing model beliefs
out.rationale: Cohen et al. propose using several LM instances in factuality detection instead of one examiner. Du et al. report multi-agent debate improves factual accuracy (biographies 66.0 to 73.8, MMLU 63.9 to 71.1 versus single agent); this improves answer generation, not detection of another model's false claims, so the two share the question in different settings.
out.scope: proposed SAME_QUESTION_DIFFERENT_SETTING: whether several LM instances improve factuality over a single model, measured for answer accuracy on biographies and MMLU (Du et al.) and proposed for factuality detection (Cohen et al.)
